item.title: Khatibzadeh: Iran seeks a tangible guarantee from US to end the war
item.description: Moscow, IRNA — Head of the Center for Political and International Studies at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Saeed Khatibzadeh stating that Tehran’s policy is to resolve issues diplomatically—despite US breaches of commitment and acts of betrayal—described Iran’s seven-day initiative as being in line with this approach, adding that Iran seeks concrete US guarantees to end the war.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86280523/Khatibzadeh-Iran-seeks-a-tangible-guarantee-from-the-US-to-end

Moscow, IRNA — Head of the Center for Political and International Studies at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Saeed Khatibzadeh stating that Tehran’s policy is to resolve issues diplomatically—despite US breaches of commitment and acts of betrayal—described Iran’s seven-day initiative as being in line with this approach, adding that Iran seeks concrete US guarantees to end the war.

item.title: Iran warns against abuse of security council by US and its allies
item.description: New York, IRNA – Gholamhossein Darzi, Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations, emphasized that the Security Council must uphold the UN Charter and international law while refraining from any politicization or abuse of its procedures; anf also warned that the United States and its allies have repeatedly exploited the Council’s procedures and powers to advance short-sighted political agendas.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86280512/Iran-warns-against-abuse-of-security-council-by-US-and-its-allies

New York, IRNA – Gholamhossein Darzi, Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations, emphasized that the Security Council must uphold the UN Charter and international law while refraining from any politicization or abuse of its procedures; anf also warned that the United States and its allies have repeatedly exploited the Council’s procedures and powers to advance short-sighted political agendas.
